"""One-episode visual servo controller for RoboCasa GR1 plate-to-pan."""
import argparse, json, pathlib, numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

ROOT=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
CAMS=['egoview','robot0_eye_in_left_hand','robot0_agentview_center']

def command(r, target, steps=20, name='step', cameras=CAMS, depth=True):
    target=np.asarray(target,dtype=np.float64)
    a=np.repeat(target[None,:],steps,axis=0)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,cameras=cameras,video='none',include_depth=depth,note=name)
    dest=ROOT/name
    res.save(str(dest))
    p=dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    print(json.dumps({'name':name,'steps':res.meta['control_steps'],'time_left_s':res.meta['time_left_s'],'eef_left':[p.get('eef_left_'+k) for k in 'xyz'],'eef_right':[p.get('eef_right_'+k) for k in 'xyz'],'cmd_left':[p['cmd_left_'+k] for k in ('x','y','z','rx','ry','rz','little','ring','middle','index','thumb_flexion','thumb_rotation')],'left_joints':[p[k] for k in p if k.startswith('gripper0_left_') and k.endswith('pos')]},indent=2))
    return res

def main():
    a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('name');a.add_argument('--left',nargs=3,type=float);a.add_argument('--right',nargs=3,type=float);a.add_argument('--left-fingers',nargs=6,type=float);a.add_argument('--right-fingers',nargs=6,type=float);a.add_argument('--steps',type=int,default=20);args=a.parse_args()
    r=Robot();obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='none')
    p=dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'],obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
    target=np.array([p['cmd_'+side+'_'+k] for side in ('right','left') for k in ('x','y','z','rx','ry','rz','little','ring','middle','index','thumb_flexion','thumb_rotation')],dtype=float)
    # Reorder into 12 pose coordinates followed by 12 finger commands.
    target=np.r_[target[:6],target[12:18],target[6:12],target[18:24]]
    if args.right: target[:3]=args.right
    if args.left: target[6:9]=args.left
    if args.right_fingers: target[12:18]=args.right_fingers
    if args.left_fingers: target[18:24]=args.left_fingers
    command(r,target,args.steps,args.name)
if __name__=='__main__': main()
